title: Anne Holton
description: During a Virginia Board of Education meeting Holton said that she has no problems with socialist governments.
body:
# Anne Holton

# School Board Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/03/holton-profile.jpg)

- Holton is the wife of Sen. Tim Kaine.
- She previously served as a member of the Virginia Board of Education. During a Feb. 2023 **[meeting](https://web.archive.org/web/20250805041755/https:/newsindiatimes.com/virginia-senate-rejects-youngkins-indian-american-nominee-for-board-of-education/)** she said, “you cannot reference the Declaration of Independence and Constitution as remarkable documents without acknowledging they contain fundamental flaws.”
- During a Virginia Board of Education meeting **[said that](https://x.com/VA_GOP/status/1623327513417027584)** “I’m not comfortable” **[with language stating](https://www.doe.virginia.gov/data-policy-funding/virginia-board-of-education/board-meetings-agendas-and-minutes/february-1-2-2023)** that “centralized government planning in the form of socialism or communist political systems is incompatible with democracy.”
- Believes that **[diversity is a strength.](https://web.archive.org/web/20260320194454/https:/www.winchesterstar.com/news/clarke/holton-a-virginia-for-all-includes-immigrants/article_8b21d6f4-ab01-517d-ac12-6cb85d88012d.html)**
